parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Set the value to **DOMAIN**.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The key-value pair of a tag.

parameters.name: TagOwnerBid
parameters.description: The business ID of the tag owner.

parameters.name: TagOwnerUid
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the tag belongs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cdn list-tag-resources --tag-owner-uid 123xxxx --tag-owner-bid 26842 --resource-type DOMAIN --next-token QpgBAAAAAABsb2dzL2RzLw== --resource-id example.com --tag Value=testValue Key=testKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cdn ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'example.com' --Tag.1.Key testKey --TagOwnerUid 123xxxx --NextToken 'QpgBAAAAAABsb2dzL2RzLw==' --TagOwnerBid 26842 --Tag.1.Value testValue --ResourceType DOMAIN
